correctness.rationale: Condition on Pi(i)=i, delete that fixed entry, and standardize to uniform sigma in S_{n-1}. Inserting i retains all old upper records, adding exactly one when the first m=i-1 standardized values are {1,...,m}; the event has probability 1/binom(n-1,m). On that event the two blocks are independent uniform permutations, so E[t^R|fixed_i]=[t^(overline(n-1))+(t-1)t^(overline(i-1))t^(overline(n-i))]/(n-1)!. Reflection of the two block sizes gives full conditional distribution symmetry. Differentiation yields Cov(1_{Pi(i)=i},R)=1/(n binom(n-1,i-1))-1/n². Binomial unimodality proves positive exactly i=1,2,n-1,n for n>=5, negative otherwise, and sum over i proves total-fixed-point covariance positive with n times covariance approaching 1. Independent exact enumeration of permutations for n=2..7 verified every conditional mean and reflection, not the all-n theorem. All-complex-t polynomial identity, n>=2; four-label sign result n>=5.
